text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City Policy or by-laws. Multiplex Global Canada Ltd. is constructing a 33-storey mixed-use office building with a 10-storey podium. The site is bounded by Richmond Street West to the north, Cloud Gardens Park to the east, Temperance Street to the south, and existing commercial uses (353-359 Bay Street) to the west. Transportation Services is requesting approval to close the north sidewalk and a portion of the westbound curb lane on Temperance Street for a period of 28 months (i.e. May 29, 2019 to September 30, 2021) to accommodate the construction staging area. Pedestrian movements will be accommodated within the closed curb lane.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Approved the closure of the north sidewalk and a 5.2 metre wide portion of the westbound curb lane on the north side of Temperance Street, between a point 29.5 metres east of Bay Street and a point 97 metres further east and provision of a temporary pedestrian walkway within the closed portion of the westbound curb lane, from May 29, 2019 to September 30, 2021. 2. Designated Temperance Street, between Bay Street and a point 39 metres west of Yonge Street, as one-way for westbound traffic only. 3. Rescinded the existing parking machine regulation in effect from 8:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m., Monday to Saturday; and 1:00 p.m. to 9:00 p.m., Sunday, on the north side of Temperance Street, between a point 15 metres east of Bay Street and a point 108 metres further east. 4.
